name: Misabar Al'Amal
about: Misabar Al'Amal (2020-047A, MBRSC), launched 2020 Jul 19. Its phases from GCAT: Mars, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
